dialogues.speaker: Brek
dialogues.text: I was forced to do this in order to make a living. My hands were tied.

dialogues.speaker: Brek
dialogues.text: You scared me! I thought it was another creditor coming for me.

dialogues.speaker: Brek
dialogues.text: I'm thinking of starting a new business. If this deal goes through, I'll be sitting atop a goldmine. I'll have enough Mora to leave the Court of Fontaine and start anew.

dialogues.speaker: Brek
dialogues.text: But that cowardly Debal... Bah! He deserves to be poor. He couldn't hold onto Mora even if you handed it to him on a silver platter.

dialogues.speaker: Brek
dialogues.text: Goodbye for now. Those creditors shouldn't be able to find me here, right?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Leave? But what about your creditors?

dialogues.speaker: Brek
dialogues.text: They really took me for a ride with this loan. When I borrowed that sum, I had no idea they'd come up with so many terms and charge me interest that was sky high.

dialogues.speaker: Brek
dialogues.text: If I were only expected to pay back the principal, I wouldn't exactly be overjoyed, but I could accept it. But now they're telling me that the interest alone has grown to three times the principal!

dialogues.speaker: Brek
dialogues.text: If they think I'm gonna pay that, they're delusional. I was hoodwinked. This was never my debt to begin with!

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: So... what exactly is this business?

dialogues.speaker: Brek
dialogues.text: Hmph, I can't tell you unless... you're willing to join me.

dialogues.speaker: Brek
dialogues.text: I can give you a little hint though. It was a deal with a prominent merchant from Snezhnaya. He struck the deal with me personally, hehehe.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Then why did you borrow Mora in the first place?

dialogues.speaker: Brek
dialogues.text: I was in dire need of Mora for my business at the time, but no one was willing to lend me a cent. I had no choice but to approach that bunch of crooks for a small loan.

dialogues.speaker: Brek
dialogues.text: It doesn't matter now anyway. Once I get my hands on that thing and send it out, all of this will be settled.
